title: rosa viscaria var. parvula
intro: Rosa viscaria var. parvula, commonly known as Dwarf Alpine Rose, is a rare and compact variety of the Rosa viscaria plant species. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, promote wound healing, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rosa viscaria var. parvula include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions, such as eczema, acne, and cold sores. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
